question:
Six letters P, Q, R, S, T and U are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to 'R'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2ff27215b47e200fb7aabefa36a9164b696e88ebfdacb0de026a2c7d6ebd6b1.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As T and U are common on both the dices, it is clear that the remaining will be opposites

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d2ffcc839e7848ef54bb56ac56d6c028b9f40f2a0afddca87b56a6a074328d1.png] 

Opposite pairs:

S → R

So, the opposite side of "R" will be side "S".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
